scope: Targeted final reassessment of ten existing unresolved companies; no discovery.
method: Fresh primary product/case/contact/legal pages, targeted official searches and public direct HTTP recovery. Prior evidence retained. No private endpoints, messages, database writes or browser actions.
meaning: This closes the finite research pass, not the factual questions. All ten have concrete findings and a decisive remaining question. No candidate is excluded for silence, lack of patents, lack of standalone SaaS or use of third-party components.

rows.finding: Official 1 August 2024 leadership announcement explicitly says offices had recently opened in Switzerland and Austria. This is affirmative historical Swiss-office evidence, stronger than a Swiss customer reference. Current office list still omits Switzerland; no closure proof or current Zurich occupancy identified.
rows.question: Does Forte currently maintain the listed Zurich office/team, and at which address?
rows.nextAction: Main can seek a current first-party office/contact confirmation; no exclusion or location deletion recommended.

rows.finding: Adnovum's dated announcement confirms April 2026 absorption into its public-sector team. Its current contact roster does not list Winterthur. The technical business continues through the successor; the unresolved issue is representation of the predecessor and its location, not technical eligibility.
rows.question: Should the existing Koch profile be represented as an Adnovum predecessor/site, and is the Winterthur location still occupied?
rows.nextAction: Prepare a successor/profile reconciliation only after address confirmation; preserve organisation and relationships.

rows.finding: Direct current HTTP read succeeds. blue.project page explicitly claims continuous development over 25 years while assigning detailed functions, licensing, support and custom adaptations to partner walkingtoyou. A shared page voice is not proof either of walkingtoweb development or of resale-only status.
rows.question: Does walkingtoweb itself contribute original continuing blue.project development, jointly with walkingtoyou, or only host and sell it?
rows.nextAction: Keep withdrawn from removals; accept explicit joint-development evidence without requiring sole ownership.

rows.finding: Current company catalogue expressly offers joint or commissioned development of modules/platforms. Beppo's own current account identifies its icentic origin and continued Zurich development, but not current icentic participation. This is substantive software work, not merely support; founder overlap alone does not attribute the separate spin-off's technology.
rows.question: Does current icentic continue developing beppo or another company-originated technology, beyond client-only development assignments?
rows.nextAction: Retain pending direct development-allocation evidence; do not infer exclusion from an outsourcing label.

rows.finding: Simulation.solar documents specialist optical computation, methodological criticism and ongoing interdisciplinary work. Direct reads recover visualisierung.ch as a Mathys page linking simulation.solar; glarecontrol.aero is an image-only placeholder, not evidence of a launched software product. Neither fact establishes or disproves original simulation-method development.
rows.question: Which simulation method, computational component or technical process does Mathys itself develop rather than only apply?
rows.nextAction: An attributable original simulation method suffices; do not demand patents or standalone software sales.

rows.finding: Current first-party imprint confirms Mecas GmbH, Zurich address and leadership. Founder-authored hiring post describes building production AI systems; company page describes vision, sensor processing and robotics. The linked Notion careers page returns 404. These establish a technical team and local identity, but do not distinguish own/joint technology from client-only projects.
rows.question: What concrete original or jointly developed system/method can be attributed to Mecas beyond commissioned implementation?
rows.nextAction: Preserve young company; unavailable job page and sparse publicity are not exclusion or dormancy evidence.

rows.finding: Fresh official homepage still identifies REASONING MACHINES INC. No primary bridge to the listed Swiss entity emerged. Similarly named GitHub/Hugging Face accounts are not accepted without identity linkage.
rows.question: Which primary source links the listed Swiss organisation/team to reasoninglabs.com and its named corporate owner?
rows.nextAction: Preserve identity hold and existing no-topic-change instruction; do not infer inactivity.

rows.finding: Current catalogue and company-published marketplace offer establish provisioning, billing and reporting functionality. Direct marketplace HTTP read returns a JavaScript application shell. The visible dependency names do not establish vendor or developer authorship; Cura360 vendor-service composition likewise does not settle Marketplace attribution.
rows.question: Who develops and maintains the publicloud Marketplace software, and what original technical contribution belongs to Scheuss/publicloud?
rows.nextAction: Do not exclude on the inaccessible rendered application or dependence on third-party libraries.

rows.finding: Two fresh first-party cases materially strengthen evidence: UMB explicitly jointly developed the VBZ E-Mail Butler with IBM/VBZ and a Belimo solution with CAS. These are actual software co-development, not generic support. The former is described as commissioned PoC; the latter implements CAS Case Manager for Belimo. The pages do not settle whether the relevant original component is continuing UMB/joint technology rather than client-only implementation. Historical ubitec/meshTec acquisitions cannot automatically import current mesoneer products.
rows.question: Does UMB maintain an original/joint component from these solutions, or another current developed technology, beyond the customer-specific implementation?
rows.nextAction: Strongest central-review candidate for retention under the joint-technology boundary. Do not call this resale-only and do not demand exclusively owned code.

rows.finding: Current uNimbus product page presents a standardised private-cloud platform across operating systems and management levels. Official history explicitly says development started in 2025; current catalogue also describes orchestration of vendor infrastructure. Original development is plausible but its concrete component/process remains unspecified. IBM/Green partnership does not negate it.
rows.question: What original technical component or developed process is maintained for uNimbus beyond managed infrastructure operation?
rows.nextAction: Preserve withdrawn exclusion; clarify development contribution without demanding a patent, new cloud stack or SaaS product.

noncompany.action: No new exclusions or classification changes warranted by this pass.
noncompany.limitations: Creathor operating-activity uncertainty remains separate from investor eligibility. Prior non-company roles, topicless exceptions and protected institutions are not re-certified from company evidence.
